partner_result_applied.use: Applied its principal 3/4-block fixed-A certificate to the explicit A_m family and proved kappa_*(A_m)=1/m, exposing an exact linear method loss.

premises.statement: Every fixed rank>=3 symmetric A has a bounded-density certificate through an invertible principal 3/4 block, with matrix-dependent 1/kappa_*(A) price.
Every one-dimensional marginal of a product density with coordinate density caps 1 is bounded by sqrt(2).

new_results.statement: Rank-three spectral forms whose three orthonormal eigenvectors have pairwise disjoint physical supports have a bounded continuous density with universal bound 2*pi; if one same-sign direction is a physical coordinate, pi*sqrt(2).

No positive universal c can force either a principal 3/4 block with sigma_min>=c or a physical cross block of rank at least three. The exact A_m family has kappa_*=1/m and all cross-block ranks<=2 while still satisfying a uniform pi*sqrt(2) density bound.

unresolved_implication: Prove a dimension-free bound in the mixed rank1-plus-rank2 regime when localized and diffuse spectral directions overlap in physical coordinates, retaining product-coordinate provenance.
next_step: Try square-root smoothing from the localized direction combined with a rank-two logarithmic small-ball estimate without treating shared-coordinate components as independent.
